name: Sorrel Nasturtium
original_name: ソレル・ナスターシャム
source:
Although she is from a distinguished family, she does not ride her high horse, but rather focuses on etiquette. Though, with that said, she sees Celery as a rival and takes on a cross attitude toward her, and for some reason, she unabashedly takes jabs at Dill. She is a girl strict with herself and with others, with no gap between her apperance and behavior.

She admires her grandfather, the former head of the Nasturtium family.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.success-corp.co.jp/software/xbox/bistro2/main_chara07.html]official website[/url].]
